# Phase Two — Twenty Improvements to the First Design

> Each critique is gevurah shaping chesed into form; through the Awtsmoos.com vessel, abundance becomes a stable norm.

1. Keep the five flat verbs immutable and put expert power under namespaces.
2. Treat `createAwtsmoos()` as composition, never a fourth semantic engine.
3. Delegate validation to `validateProceduralDefinition` rather than reimplementing schema rules.
4. Delegate per-definition compiler matching to Universal Semantic Kernel.
5. Delegate world explanation and orchestration to Procedural Portal.
6. Preserve `createUniversalAwtsmoosApi()` as the transactional world/history authority.
7. Publish a serializable pipeline descriptor showing normalization through cache/provenance intent.
8. Expose compiler catalog discovery without executor leakage.
9. Preserve explicit native/adapter/deferred/unsupported truth.
10. Make seed inheritance deterministic and test it.
11. Ensure caller-supplied canonical definitions retain semantic hashes across facade operations.
12. Make `define()` accept both canonical procedural-definition payloads and ergonomic kind/input form only if existing factories already support it.
13. Avoid automatic world wrapping when a direct semantic plan is sufficient.
14. Keep expert namespaces frozen/read-only so callers cannot replace authorities accidentally.
15. Add tests for malformed definitions and unsupported channels.
16. Add tests proving legacy Creation Portal and transactional Universal API behavior is unchanged.
17. Close the inherited Aug. 31 authored-semantics verification debt in this release.
18. Document responsibility boundaries so future agents do not build a rival API.
19. Build examples from the same public facade rather than special demo-only helpers.
20. Delay public route creation until existing examples/routes are inspected; prefer a small proof route over a giant app.
